provenance.clock: Recorder local time = UTC epoch seconds + clocks.offset. Both resolver observed and endpoint local_time require their named recorder offset.
provenance.identity: A DNS address belongs to the MAC in the lease whose inclusive interval contains normalized observation time. assets maps MAC to durable host. Historical addresses can be reused.
provenance.framing: Transfer labels are payload_hex.sequence_hex.claimed_crc16_hex.stream_id.domain. CRC16 CCITT initial FFFF covers payload bytes. Duplicate sequence/payload deliveries do not add content. Helper functions expose framing only, not detection verdicts.
provenance.trust: A loaded module is trusted only when its files.signer certificate is valid at normalized module event time and has not been revoked by that time. Host executable trust is independent. A recent transfer-related process must have a recorded parent on the same host.
provenance.authorization: A deployment authorizes exactly its host and module_hash within its inclusive UTC interval, and only when its last changes sequence has state approved. Historical approvals may be withdrawn.
provenance.investigation: The labeled acquisitions distinguish the incident from maintenance, damaged traffic and ordinary repeated delivery. Use event ordering, acquisition integrity and independent authorization evidence to identify the behavior common to incident streams. Labels exist only in the training download, never in the evaluation database.
